content:
support-ops: Heads-up: several hosted API customers reporting intermittent 502/504s from inference endpoints starting ~08:12 UTC. Error rates spiking on gateway. Logs show a lot of cache dependency failures. tagging @jordan_sre and @ingrid_reliability :eyes:

jordan_sre: I'm seeing the same in the metrics. 5xx rate up ~18% over baseline. Stacktraces show repeated memcached auth/reconnect errors and prefix cache fallthroughs. Example from router logs: "ERR prefix_cache: memcached_auth_fail key=ctx:abcd.., pool=kv-pfx, err=SASL AUTH failed"

alex_prod: customer A support case attached: request_id=rf-9a3c, got 502 with upstream error: "cache fallback -> origin overload -> gateway 502". They reported it started immediately after a cert rotation window.

deploy-bot: Notice: cert rotation job cert-rotate-v2 applied to infra/credentials at 08:05 UTC by ops-team (job id: cr-2026-03-17-08).

jordan_sre: that aligns. Memcached clients using mTLS/SASL config may have failed to authenticate after rotation. When clients hit auth errors, we fall back to origin which causes higher latency and 5xx.

ingrid_reliability: quick mitigation options: 1) revert cert rotation (if safe) 2) restart cache-proxy sidecars so they pick up new certs 3) temporarily increase circuit-breaker threshold and cache TTLs to avoid origin fanout. Which can we do fast?

support-ops: We need something customer-facing fast. Proposed support reply: "We're investigating elevated 5xxs on hosted inference; suspected cache auth issue; mitigation in progress; ETA 30-60m". Anyone want to run quick checks and a targeted restart?

jordan_sre: Running live checks now. Commands I'm using: 
```
# memcached auth test
echo "stats" | nc memcached-01.prod.kv 11211
# check proxy logs
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=kv-proxy --since=10m | grep "SASL"
# gateway error samples
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -d '{"model":"rwd/opt-8b","input":"hi"}'
```

jordan_sre: quick log snippet: "2026-03-17T08:11:58Z prefix_cache.go:421: memcached auth error: SASL PLAIN: authentication failed for client-id=svc-inference-7"

ingrid_reliability: I can roll the kv-proxy sidecars in prod (canary first) and then restart memcached nodes if roll doesn't clear. Plan: rollout restart deployment/kv-proxy -n infra --selector=canary=true; wait 2m; expand if healthy.

alex_prod: +1 to canary rollout. Also prepare a canned support message for larger impacted customers and ask billing-bot to suppress billing noise for impacted requests for the window.

billing-bot: Noted. I can flag impacted customer-A and pause usage alerts for requests returning 5xx between 08:05-09:00 UTC if you supply request IDs or affected org_ids.

support-ops: Jordan — do you see certificate validation errors between proxies and memcached? Can you paste one example trace?

jordan_sre: pasted more logs: "tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate" and the memcached client stack shows SASL exchange aborted. Looks like clients with rotated certs are failing until restarted.

ingrid_reliability: Executed canary restart of kv-proxy at 08:18. Observed memcached auths succeed on canary after restart, error rate for that pod dropped to near zero. Expanding rollout now.

support-ops: Notifying customers. Posting to status: "Degraded performance and elevated 5xx on hosted inference due to cache auth regressions after cert rotation. Mitigation: rolling restart of cache proxy sidecars; engineers are monitoring. ETA 30m."

customer-A: Thanks for the update. We're seeing reduced errors but still occasional 502s. Any ETA on full resolution?

jordan_sre: After full rollout (completed 08:26), error rate dropped ~90%. We're monitoring for residual origin load. Still sampling a few 502s that look like in-flight requests hit fallback path; should clear in a few minutes as caches repopulate.

ingrid_reliability: Postmortem action items we should capture: 
- add graceful cert hot-reload to kv-proxy so restarts aren't required 
- add better telemetry to detect memcached SASL failures earlier (alert at 5 auth errors/min) 
- add automated circuit-breaker to rate-limit fallback fanout to origin (protect gateways) 
- review our cert rotation runbook to include cache-proxy restart step and pre-checks

support-ops: I'll create the support follow-up and add customers impacted. Template for customers: "Root cause: cache client authentication failures following a credential rotation causing fallback to origin and increased 5xx responses. Mitigation: restarted cache proxies to pick up new creds; monitoring shows errors returned to baseline. We're implementing hot-reload and alerts to reduce recurrence."

alex_prod: Can someone add the list of affected org_ids to the billing suppression? billing-bot needs org ids.

billing-bot: Provide a CSV of org_ids and I will apply a suppression tag for 08:05-08:30 window.

support-ops: Uploaded csv to /shared/incidents/3415678901/affected_orgs.csv and sent to billing-bot.

jordan_sre: final check at 08:33: gateway 5xxs near baseline, memcached auth errors gone. Closing handoff to postmortem. :white_check_mark:

ingrid_reliability: adding postmortem draft to docs and assigning owners.

support-ops: Thanks everyone — will follow up with customer comms and postmortem.
